source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 1 exercise solved (PDF 17-21), with the printed numerical answers checked.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 1 (Measurements) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai (kitab MCQs ki key nahi deti); short, wazahati aur tafseeli sawalon ke model jawab aur numericals ka qadam ba qadam hal diya gaya hai. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Sahi jawab par (✓) ka nishan lagayein.

blocks.prompt:
1.1 The purpose of study and discoveries in Physics is:
(Physics ke mutalea aur daryafton ka maqsad kya hai?)

options.text: sitaron ke darmiyan khala (interstellar space) ki chhaan been
jang mein tabahi wali technology banana

blocks.explanation: Physics science, technology aur engineering ke bunyadi usool deti hai, aur is ki cheezon ne hamari zindagi mein aasaniyan barhai hain (1.1). Is ka maqsad insaniyat ki behtari hai.

blocks.prompt:
1.2 The length of a steel pipe is in between 0.7 m to 0.8 m. Identify from the following, the appropriate instrument to be used for an accuracy of 0.001 m.
(Steel pipe ki lambai 0.7 m aur 0.8 m ke darmiyan hai. 0.001 m ki durusti (accuracy) ke liye munasib aala (instrument) pehchanein.)
blocks.explanation: 0.001 m = 1 mm hai, jo metre rule ka least count (sab se chhoti peemaish) hai, aur metre rule 1 m tak naap sakta hai. Screw gauge aur Vernier Callipers sirf chand centimetre naapte hain, aur 1 m se kam ke liye 10 m ka tape zaroori nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal 1.2 ke options par (a), (b), (b), (c) chhapa hai. Yahan unhein usi tarteeb mein (a) se (d) likha gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1.3 The diameter of a steel ball is measured using a Vernier callipers and its reading is shown in the figure. What is the diameter of the steel ball?
[Figure: a main scale marked 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 cm; the Vernier scale (marked 5 at its middle) slides on it, with its zero just at the 1.4 cm mark.]
(Steel ki gaind ka qutar (diameter) Vernier callipers se naapa gaya aur reading figure mein hai. Gaind ka diameter kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Vernier Callipers ka least count = 0.01 cm.
Main scale reading = 1.4 cm (Vernier ka zero 1.4 cm ke nishan par hai).
Vernier reading: Vernier ki zero line milti (coincide karti) hai, is liye 0 × 0.01 cm = 0.00 cm.
Diameter = 1.4 cm + 0.00 cm = 1.40 cm.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Vernier ki reading ka tareeqa: (1) Vernier ke zero se pehle main scale ka aakhri nishan = main scale reading; (2) Vernier ki jo line main scale ki kisi line se bilkul mil jaye, us ka number × least count = Vernier reading; (3) dono ko jama karein. Kitab ki tasveer bohat chhoti hai; options mein sirf 1.40 cm hi 1.4 cm ki main scale reading se mel khata hai.

blocks.prompt:
1.4 The figure shows the reading on a micrometer screw gauge used to measure diameter of a thin rod. One complete turn of the thimble is 0.50 mm and there are 50 lines on the circular scale. The diameter of the rod is:
[Figure: on the main scale the thimble edge has uncovered the 3 mm mark and the half-millimetre mark after it; the datum line meets the circular scale between the 20 and 15 marks, at 17.]
(Figure mein patli rod ka diameter naapne wale micrometer screw gauge ki reading hai. Thimble ka aik poora chakkar 0.50 mm hai aur circular scale par 50 lines hain. Rod ka diameter kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Least count = pitch / circular divisions ki tadaad = 0.50 mm / 50 = 0.01 mm.
Main scale reading = 3.5 mm (3 mm aur us ke baad aadhe millimetre ka nishan nazar aa raha hai).
Circular scale reading = 17 × 0.01 mm = 0.17 mm.
Diameter = 3.5 mm + 0.17 mm = 3.67 mm.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Is screw gauge ka pitch 0.50 mm hai, is liye main scale par neeche wale aadhe millimetre ke nishan bhi ginein. Agar aadha nishan chhor dein to ghalat jawab 3.17 mm aata hai.

blocks.prompt:
1.5 The number of significant figures of a measurement are defined as:
(Kisi peemaish ke significant figures (bamaani hindse) kya hain?)

options.text: yeh peemaish mein mushahide ki durusti (accuracy) dikhate hain
yeh woh hindse hain jin par kaafi bharosa hai
yeh peemaish ke yaqeeni hindse aur pehla mashkook (doubtful) hindsa hain

blocks.explanation: Section 1.4 teeno baatein kehta hai: significant figures woh hindse hain jin par hamein bharosa hai, yeh aale ki durusti dikhate hain, aur yeh yaqeeni hindse aur pehla mashkook hindsa hain. Is liye "all of the above".

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal 1.5 ke options par (a), (c), (d), (c) chhapa hai. Yahan unhein usi tarteeb mein (a) se (d) likha gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1.6 The number of significant figures in the measured mass 2500.0 kg is:
(Naapi gayi mass 2500.0 kg mein kitne significant figures hain?)
blocks.explanation: Decimal number mein significant figure ke daayein zeros bhi significant hote hain. Is liye 2, 5, 0, 0, 0 sab significant hain: paanch.

blocks.prompt:
1.7 The sum 12 kg + 2.02 kg + 5.1 kg according to appropriate precision is:
(12 kg + 2.02 kg + 5.1 kg ka majmua munasib precision ke saath kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 12 + 2.02 + 5.1 = 19.12 kg. Jama mein jawab utne decimal places rakhta hai jitne sab se kam decimal wale number mein hon; 12 kg mein koi decimal nahi, is liye jawab 19 kg.

blocks.prompt:
1.8 The answer to appropriate precision for the subtraction (1.126-0.97268) is:
((1.126 - 0.97268) ka munasib precision ke saath jawab kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 1.126 - 0.97268 = 0.15332. Sab se kam decimal places (teen) 1.126 mein hain, is liye jawab 0.153.

blocks.prompt:
1.9 The answer of the product (2.8723x1.6) to the appropriate number of significant figures is:
((2.8723 × 1.6) ka zarb munasib significant figures ke saath kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2.8723 × 1.6 = 4.59568. Zarb mein jawab utne significant figures rakhta hai jitne sab se kam wale factor mein hon; 1.6 mein do hain, is liye jawab 4.6.

blocks.prompt:
1.10 The answer to the mathematical division (45.2 ÷ 6.0) in appropriate number of significant figures is:
((45.2 ÷ 6.0) ki taqseem ka jawab munasib significant figures mein kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 45.2 ÷ 6.0 = 7.5333. 6.0 mein do significant figures hain, is liye jawab 7.5.

blocks.prompt:
1.11 The answer to the following mathematical operation 24.4 m x 100 m / 5.0 m to the appropriate number of significant figures is:
(24.4 m × 100 m / 5.0 m ka jawab munasib significant figures mein kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 24.4 m × 100 m / 5.0 m = 488 m. Sab se kam durust factor 5.0 m mein do significant figures hain, is liye jawab 4.9 × 10² m (scientific notation mein do significant figures saaf nazar aate hain).

blocks.prompt:
1.12 The ratio of the dimensions of force and energy is:
(Force aur energy ki dimensions ki nisbat (ratio) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: [F] / [E] = [MLT⁻²] / [ML²T⁻²] = [L⁻¹].

blocks.prompt:
1.13 Identify which pair from the following does not have identical dimensions.
(Kaun sa jora (pair) aik jaisi dimensions nahi rakhta?)

options.text: Moment of inertia aur moment of force

blocks.explanation: Moment of inertia (mr²) = [ML²], jab ke moment of force (torque, rF) = [ML²T⁻²]. Baqi jore barabar hain: work aur torque [ML²T⁻²]; angular momentum aur Planck's constant [ML²T⁻¹]; impulse aur momentum [MLT⁻¹].

blocks.prompt:
1.14 The following figures are of the same Vernier calipers. Figure (1) shows the reading when the jaws are closed while Fig. (2) shows the reading when a solid cylinder is placed between the jaws. The length of the cylinder is:
[Figure (1): with the jaws closed, the Vernier zero lies a little to the right of the main-scale zero (positive zero error). Figure (2): with the cylinder between the jaws, the scale reads about 3.30 cm.]
(Dono figures aik hi Vernier calipers ki hain. Figure (1) jaws band hone par reading, aur Figure (2) jaws ke darmiyan cylinder rakhne par reading dikhati hai. Cylinder ki lambai kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Fig. (1): Vernier ka zero main scale ke zero se daayein hai, is liye zero error positive hai: +0.04 cm (Vernier ki 4th line milti hai, L.C. 0.01 cm).
Fig. (2): naapi gayi reading = 3.30 cm.
Durust lambai = reading - zero error = 3.30 cm - 0.04 cm = 3.26 cm.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Zero error (sifar ki ghalti): jaws band hon aur Vernier ka zero main scale ke zero se aage (daayein) ho to error positive hai, aur us ko reading se minus karte hain. Peeche (baayein) ho to negative error, jo reading mein jama hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
1.15 The least count of an instrument determines:
(Kisi aale ka least count kya tay karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.5: peemaish ki precision aala tay karta hai; least count jitna chhota, peemaish utni precise. Accuracy fractional ya percentage uncertainty se tay hoti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal 1.15 ke options par (a), (c), (c), (d) chhapa hai. Yahan unhein usi tarteeb mein (a) se (d) likha gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1.16 A measuring tape has been graduated with a minimum scale division of 0.2 cm. The allowed reading using this tape may be:
(Measuring tape ki sab se chhoti division 0.2 cm hai. Is tape se kaun si reading mumkin hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tape sirf 0.2 cm ke qadmon mein parhta hai: ... 80.4, 80.6, 80.8 cm. Options mein sirf 80.6 cm (= 403 × 0.2 cm) us ki scale par aata hai.

blocks.text: Short Answer Questions (mukhtasar sawal)

blocks.prompt:
1.1 What are base units and derived units? Give some examples of both these units.
(Base units aur derived units kya hain? Dono ki misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Base units: saat aazad (independent) base quantities ke units, maslan metre (m), kilogram (kg), second (s), ampere (A), kelvin (K), candela (cd), mole (mol).
Derived units: jo base units par munhasir (depend) hon, maslan newton (N = kg m s⁻²), joule (J = kg m² s⁻²), watt (W), pascal (Pa), coulomb (C = A s).

blocks.prompt:
1.2 How many significant figures should be retained in the following?
(i) Multiplying or dividing several numbers (ii) Adding or subtracting numbers
(Neeche ki surat mein kitne significant figures rakhne chahiye? (i) kai numbers ki zarb ya taqseem (ii) numbers ka jama ya tafreeq)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Zarb ya taqseem: jawab mein utne significant figures jitne sab se kam significant figures wale factor mein hon.
(ii) Jama ya tafreeq: jawab mein utne decimal places jitne sab se kam decimal places wale number mein hon (yahan decimal ki jagah aham hai, significant figures ki tadaad nahi).

blocks.prompt:
1.3 How is the Vernier scale related to the main scale of a Vernier Callipers? What is meant by L.C. of the Vernier Callipers?
(Vernier Callipers mein Vernier scale ka main scale se kya talluq hai? Vernier Callipers ke L.C. se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Vernier scale main scale par phisalta hai; is ki 10 divisions main scale ki 9 divisions (9 mm) ke barabar hain, is liye aik Vernier division 0.9 mm, yani main scale division se 0.1 mm chhoti.
L.C. (least count) woh sab se chhoti lambai hai jo callipers naap sakta hai: L.C. = 1 MSD - 1 VSD = 1 mm/10 = 0.1 mm = 0.01 cm. (chapter se bahar: Vernier Callipers is chapter mein bayan nahi.)

blocks.prompt:
1.4 Write the following numbers in scientific notation.
a) 143.7 (b) 206.4 x 10²
(Yeh numbers scientific notation mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Scientific notation mein decimal se pehle sirf aik ghair-sifar (non-zero) hindsa hota hai.
(a) 143.7 = 1.437 × 10²
(b) 206.4 × 10² = 2.064 × 10⁴

blocks.prompt:
1.5 Write the following numbers using correct prefixes:
(a) 580 x 10² g (b) 0.45 x 10⁻⁶ s
(Yeh numbers sahi prefixes ke saath likhein.)

1.6 Kinetic energy of a body of mass m moving with speed v is given by 1/2 mv². What are the dimensions of kinetic energy?
(m mass aur v speed wale jism ki kinetic energy ½mv² hai. Kinetic energy ki dimensions kya hain?)
blocks.explanation:
½ number ki koi dimension nahi.
[K.E.] = [m][v]² = [M][LT⁻¹]² = [ML²T⁻²] (work jaisi; unit joule).

blocks.prompt:
1.7 How many significant figures are there in the following measurements?
(i) 37 km (ii) 0.002953 m (iii) 7.50034 cm (iv) 200.0 m
(In peemaishon mein kitne significant figures hain?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) 37 km: 2
(ii) 0.002953 m: 4 (baayein ke zeros significant nahi)
(iii) 7.50034 cm: 6 (hindson ke darmiyan zeros significant hain)
(iv) 200.0 m: 4 (decimal number mein hindse ke baad zeros significant hain)

blocks.prompt:
1.8 Write the dimensions of: (i) Planck's constant (ii) angular velocity
(In ki dimensions likhein: (i) Planck's constant (ii) angular velocity.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) h = E/f: [h] = [ML²T⁻²]/[T⁻¹] = [ML²T⁻¹]
(ii) ω = θ/t, aur angle θ ki koi dimension nahi: [ω] = [T⁻¹]

blocks.text: Constructed Response Questions (wazahati sawal)

blocks.prompt:
1.1 Why do we find it useful to have two units for the amount of a substance, the kilogram and the mole?
(Maadde ki miqdaar ke liye do units, kilogram aur mole, kyun mufeed hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Kilogram kisi cheez ki mass (maadde ki miqdaar aur inertia) naapta hai; yeh wazan, force, momentum aur energy mein kaam aata hai.
Mole maadde ki miqdaar zarron (particles) ki tadaad ke hisaab se naapta hai (1 mol = 6.02 × 10²³ particles). Chemical reactions zarra zarra hoti hain, is liye wahan mole aasan hai.
Mukhtalif cheezon ki barabar mass mein zarron ki tadaad mukhtalif hoti hai, is liye dono units zaroori hain.

blocks.prompt:
1.2 Three students measured the length of a rod with a scale on which minimum division is 1 mm and recorded as: (i) 0.4235 m (ii) 0.42 m (iii) 0.424 m. Which record is correct and why?
(Teen talaba ne 1 mm ki sab se chhoti division wali scale se rod naapi aur (i) 0.4235 m (ii) 0.42 m (iii) 0.424 m likha. Kaun sa record sahi hai aur kyun?)
blocks.explanation:
Record (iii) 0.424 m sahi hai.
Least count 1 mm = 0.001 m hai, is liye reading metre mein teesre decimal tak likhi jaye.
0.4235 m 0.1 mm ki precision ka dawa karta hai jo yeh scale nahi de sakti; 0.42 m sirf centimetre tak hai aur scale ki precision zaya karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
1.3 Why is the kilogram (not the gram), the base unit of mass.
(Mass ka base unit kilogram kyun hai, gram kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation:
SI system metre, kilogram aur second par bana hai, taake derived units mein izafi factor na aaye: 1 N = 1 kg × 1 m s⁻², 1 J = 1 N × 1 m. Gram lene se har derived unit mein 10⁻³ jaise factor aate.
Gram rozmarra ki masses ke liye bohat chhota bhi hai, aur mass ka standard 1 kg ka banaya gaya tha. (chapter se bahar: chapter yeh wajah nahi deta.)

blocks.prompt:
1.4 Consider the equation; P = Q + R
If Q and R both have the dimensions of [MLT], what are the dimensions of P? What are the units of P in SI? If the dimensions of Q were different from those of R, could we determine dimensions of P?
(Equation P = Q + R mein agar Q aur R dono ki dimensions [MLT] hon to P ki dimensions aur SI unit kya hain? Agar Q aur R ki dimensions mukhtalif hon to kya P ki dimensions maloom ho saktin?)
blocks.explanation:
Sirf aik jaisi dimensions wali quantities jama ho sakti hain, aur un ka majmua bhi wahi dimensions rakhta hai: [P] = [MLT].
P ka SI unit: kg m s.
Agar Q aur R ki dimensions mukhtalif hon to woh jama nahi ho saktin; equation homogeneous (dimension mein durust) nahi rahegi, is liye P ki dimensions maloom nahi ho saktin.

blocks.prompt:
1.5 What is the least count of a clock if it has:
(a) Hour's hand, minute's hand and second's hand
(b) Hour's hand and minute's hand
(Ghari ka least count kya hai agar us mein: (a) ghante, minute aur second ki suiyan hon (b) sirf ghante aur minute ki suiyan hon?)
blocks.explanation:
Least count = sab se chhota waqt jo ghari dikha sake.
(a) 1 second (second ki sui aik division = 1 s).
(b) 1 minute (minute ki sui aik division = 1 min).

blocks.prompt:
1.6 How can the diameter of a round pencil be measured using metre rule with the same accuracy as that of Vernier Callipers? Describe.
(Metre rule se gol pencil ka diameter Vernier Callipers jitni durusti se kaise naapa ja sakta hai? Bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
10 aik jaisi gol pencils mez par aik doosre se mila kar saath saath rakhein, aur dono siron par lakri ke blocks rakhein.
Blocks ka darmiyani faasla metre rule (least count 0.1 cm) se naapein, maslan 7.5 cm.
Aik pencil ka diameter = 7.5 cm / 10 = 0.75 cm.
Uncertainty bhi 10 se taqseem hoti hai: 0.1 cm / 10 = 0.01 cm, jo Vernier Callipers ke least count ke barabar hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yahi tareeqa kitab ke "periodic uncertainty" wale usool jaisa hai: kai cheezon ko aik saath naap kar tadaad se taqseem karein to uncertainty bhi utni hi kam ho jaati hai.

blocks.prompt:
1.7 How would be the readings differ if the screw gauge is used instead of a Vernier Callipers to measure the thickness of a glass plate?
(Agar shishe ki plate ki motai Vernier Callipers ke bajaye screw gauge se naapi jaye to readings mein kya farq hoga?)
blocks.explanation:
Vernier Callipers ka least count = 0.01 cm; screw gauge ka least count = 0.001 cm (0.01 mm), das guna chhota.
Is liye screw gauge ki reading mein aik significant figure zyada hota hai aur woh zyada precise hoti hai, maslan Vernier: 0.25 cm; screw gauge: 0.253 cm (2.53 mm).
Patli plate ke liye percentage uncertainty taqreeban 4% (0.01/0.25) se ghat kar 0.4% (0.001/0.253) reh jaati hai, is liye screw gauge ki reading zyada accurate bhi hai.

blocks.prompt:
1.8 Write the correct reading of the length of a solid cylinder as shown in the figure if there is an error of +0.02 cm in the Vernier Callipers.
[Figure: main scale 0 to 4 cm; the zero of the Vernier scale is at the 2.7 cm mark, and the zero line of the Vernier scale coincides with that main-scale line.]
(Agar Vernier Callipers mein +0.02 cm ka error ho to figure mein dikhaye gaye solid cylinder ki lambai ki sahi reading likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Least count = 0.01 cm.
Main scale reading = 2.7 cm
Vernier scale reading = 0 × 0.01 cm = 0.00 cm (Vernier ki zero line milti hai)
Naapi gayi reading = 2.7 cm + 0.00 cm = 2.70 cm
Zero error = +0.02 cm, is liye zero correction = -0.02 cm
Sahi lambai = 2.70 cm - 0.02 cm = 2.68 cm

blocks.prompt:
1.9 There are 50 divisions on the circular scale of a screw gauge. If the head (thimble) of the screw is given 10 revolutions, then the spindle advances by 5 mm. There is also zero error as the 2nd division of the circular scale coincides with the datum line and zero of circular scale is below the datum line. What is the thickness of a glass slab as measured by the described screw gauge shown in the figure?
[Figure: main scale marked 0 and 5 mm; the thimble edge has uncovered the 6.5 mm mark; the datum line meets the circular scale at about the 13th division.]
(Screw gauge ke circular scale par 50 divisions hain. Thimble ko 10 chakkar dene se spindle 5 mm aage barhta hai. Circular scale ki 2nd division datum line se milti hai aur circular scale ka zero datum line se neeche hai (zero error). Figure mein dikhaye gaye screw gauge se shishe ki slab ki motai kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Pitch = faasla / chakkar = 5 mm / 10 = 0.5 mm
Least count = pitch / circular divisions = 0.5 mm / 50 = 0.01 mm
Zero error: circular scale ka zero datum line se neeche hai, is liye error positive: +2 × 0.01 mm = +0.02 mm
Main scale reading = 6.5 mm
Circular scale reading = 13 × 0.01 mm = 0.13 mm
Naapi gayi reading = 6.5 mm + 0.13 mm = 6.63 mm
Sahi motai = 6.63 mm - 0.02 mm = 6.61 mm
(chapter se bahar: screw gauge is chapter mein bayan nahi.)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer bohat chhoti chhapi hai; reading (6.5 mm aur 13 divisions) tasveer se andaza hai, is liye exam mein tareeqa poora likhein: pitch, least count, zero error ka nishan (+ ya -), main scale reading, circular scale reading, phir zero error minus karein.

blocks.prompt:
1.10 What is meant by a dimensionless quantity? Give one example.
(Dimensionless quantity (be-dimension miqdaar) se kya muraad hai? Aik misal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Dimensionless quantity ki koi dimension nahi hoti; aam tor par yeh aik jaisi dimensions wali do quantities ki nisbat (ratio) hoti hai.
Misal: plane angle θ = arc ki lambai / radius = [L]/[L], is liye is ki koi dimension nahi (is ka unit radian dimensionless hai).

blocks.prompt:
1.11 A student uses a screw gauge to determine the thickness of a sheet of paper. The student folds the paper three times and measures the total thickness of the folded sheet. Assume that there is no zero error in the screw gauge. The reading of screw gauge is shown in the figure. Find the thickness of the sheet.
[Figure: only the 0 mark of the main scale is uncovered; the datum line meets the circular scale (marked 35, 30, 25, 20, 15) at the 25 mark.]
(Talib-e-ilm screw gauge se kaghaz ki motai naapta hai. Woh kaghaz ko teen dafa tah (fold) kar ke poori motai naapta hai. Zero error nahi. Reading figure mein hai. Aik sheet ki motai maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Screw gauge ka least count = 0.01 mm (aam tor par yahi; kitab mein nahi likha)
Main scale reading = 0 mm
Circular scale reading = 25 × 0.01 mm = 0.25 mm
Tah kiye kaghaz ki kul motai = 0 + 0.25 mm = 0.25 mm
Har tah se tahein (layers) dugni hoti hain: 2 × 2 × 2 = 8 layers
Aik sheet ki motai = 0.25 mm / 8 = 0.031 mm ≈ 0.03 mm (3.1 × 10⁻⁵ m)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Teen dafa tah karne ka matlab teen tahein nahi: pehli tah se 2, doosri se 4, teesri se 8 tahein bante hain. Is liye kul motai ko 8 se taqseem karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
1.12 Round off each of the following numbers to 3 significant figures and write your answer in scientific notation.
(a) 0.02055 (b) 4656.5
(Har number ko 3 significant figures tak round off karein aur scientific notation mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
(a) 0.02055: girne wala hindsa 5 hai aur us se pehla hindsa (5) taaq (odd) hai, is liye aik barhta hai: 0.0206 = 2.06 × 10⁻²
(b) 4656.5: hindse aik aik kar ke hatayein, 4656.5 → 4656 → 4660 (6 > 5): 4.66 × 10³

blocks.text: Comprehensive Questions (tafseeli sawal)

blocks.prompt:
1.1 What is meant by uncertainty in a measurement? How the uncertainty in a digital instrument is indicated?
(Peemaish mein uncertainty (ghair-yaqeeni) se kya muraad hai? Digital aale mein uncertainty kaise zahir hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Peemaish mein uncertainty:
Har aala aik sab se chhoti division tak bana hota hai, jo us ki durusti ki had hai. Peemaish qareeb tareen nishan tak li jaati hai, is liye har naapi gayi miqdaar mein kuch shak hota hai. Isi shak ko uncertainty kehte hain.
Zyada se zyada uncertainty aale ki aik sab se chhoti division (least count) maani jaati hai; yeh absolute uncertainty hai, maslan millimetre wale metre rule ke liye 1 mm.
Misal: kitab ka aik kinara 10.0 cm aur doosra 33.5 cm par ho to lambai = (33.5 ± 0.05) cm - (10.0 ± 0.05) cm = (23.5 ± 0.1) cm; asal lambai 23.4 cm aur 23.6 cm ke darmiyan hai.
Uncertainty aise likhte hain:
Fractional uncertainty = absolute uncertainty / naapi gayi qeemat
Percentage uncertainty = (absolute uncertainty / naapi gayi qeemat) × 100
Digital aalon mein uncertainty:
Digital scale mein uncertainty aakhri hindse ke hilne (fluctuation) se zahir hoti hai. Agar aakhri hindsa 1 ya 2 hilta hai to woh aakhri hindsa likh lein. Agar 2 se zyada hile to reading par koi asar (maslan hawa ke jhonke) hai, aur dikhaya gaya hindsa shayad significant nahi.
Jab reading significant figures ke saath likhi jaye to us ka aakhri (andaze wala) hindsa durusti batata hai, maslan electronic balance par 3.145 g ka matlab 3.145 ± 0.001 g.

blocks.prompt:
1.2 Differentiate between the terms precision and accuracy with reference to measurement of physical quantities.
(Physical quantities ki peemaish ke hawale se precision aur accuracy mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Precision aale par munhasir hai (us ki absolute uncertainty ya least count); accuracy is par ke peemaish asal qeemat ke kitni qareeb hai (fractional ya percentage uncertainty).
Misal (1.5): metre rule se 25.5 cm (± 0.1 cm, 0.4%) kam precise magar zyada accurate hai; Vernier Callipers se 0.45 cm (± 0.01 cm, 2%) zyada precise magar kam accurate hai.

rows: Istemal hone wala aala tay karta hai
Peemaish ka asal ya maani hui qeemat ke qareeb hona
Absolute uncertainty (least count) se zahir hoti hai
Fractional ya percentage uncertainty se zahir hoti hai
Least count chhota: peemaish zyada precise
Percentage uncertainty kam: peemaish zyada accurate

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka thumb rule (kitab): Precision = kam absolute uncertainty; Accuracy = kam percentage uncertainty. Chhoti cheez ko zyada precise aale (maslan screw gauge) se naapna chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
1.3 (a) What is meant by significant figures? Write two reasons for using them in measurements. How to find the uncertainty in a timing experiment such as the time period of a simple pendulum?
(Significant figures se kya muraad hai? Peemaish mein in ke istemal ki do wajahein likhein. Simple pendulum ke time period jaise timing tajurbe mein uncertainty kaise maloom karte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Significant figures: kisi bhi peemaish mein yaqeeni (accurately known) hindse aur pehla andaze wala (mashkook) hindsa significant figures kehlate hain; yeh woh hindse hain jin par hamein bharosa hai.
Istemal ki do wajahein:
1. Yeh istemal hone wale aale ki precision dikhate hain: 3.145 g (electronic balance) 3.1 g (lever balance) se zyada durust hai.
2. Calculator ke izafi, gumrah karne wale hindse hat jaate hain, is liye nataij sahi likhe jaate hain aur un ki uncertainty nazar aati hai (aakhri hindse mein kam az kam 1 ka shak).
Timing tajurbe (simple pendulum) mein uncertainty:
1. Ziyada oscillations, maslan 20, ka waqt 0.1 s least count wali stopwatch se naapein: t = 40.6 s.
2. Time period T = 40.6 s / 20 = 2.03 s.
3. T mein uncertainty = timing aale ka least count / oscillations ki tadaad = 0.1 s / 20 = 0.005 s.
4. Is liye T = 2.030 ± 0.005 s.
Ziyada oscillations ka waqt lene se aik period ki uncertainty kam ho jaati hai. Agar timing kai dafa dohrayi jaye to average se mean deviation ko uncertainty liya jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
1.3 (b) The mass of a solid cylinder is 12.85 g. Its length is 3.35 cm and diameter is 1.25 cm. Find the density of its material expressing the uncertainty in the density.
(Solid cylinder ki mass 12.85 g, lambai 3.35 cm aur diameter 1.25 cm hai. Is ke maadde ki density uncertainty ke saath maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): m = 12.85 g (balance ka least count 0.01 g), ℓ = 3.35 cm, d = 1.25 cm (Vernier Callipers, least count 0.01 cm)
Maloom karna (Required): density ρ, uncertainty ke saath
Volume V = π(d²/4)ℓ = 3.14 × (1.25 cm)² × 3.35 cm / 4 = 4.11 cm³
Density ρ = m/V = 12.85 g / 4.11 cm³ = 3.13 g cm⁻³
m mein %age uncertainty = (0.01 g / 12.85 g) × 100 = 0.08%
d mein %age uncertainty = (0.01 cm / 1.25 cm) × 100 = 0.8%, aur d ka square hai: 2 × 0.8% = 1.6%
ℓ mein %age uncertainty = (0.01 cm / 3.35 cm) × 100 = 0.3%
ρ mein kul %age uncertainty = 0.08% + 1.6% + 0.3% ≈ 2%
Absolute uncertainty = 3.13 g cm⁻³ ka 2% = 0.06 g cm⁻³
Jawab: ρ = (3.13 ± 0.06) g cm⁻³ = (3.13 ± 0.06) × 10³ kg m⁻³

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Zarb aur taqseem mein percentage uncertainties jama hoti hain, aur power (jaise d²) ho to us ki percentage uncertainty ko power se zarb dete hain (thumb rule, section 1.6). Kitab ne least counts nahi diye; Example 1.3 ki tarah Vernier ka 0.01 cm aur balance ka 0.01 g liya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1.4 Explain with examples the writing of physical quantities into their dimensions. Write its two benefits.
(Misalon ke saath bataein ke physical quantities ko un ki dimensions mein kaise likhte hain. Is ke do faide likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Kisi physical quantity ki dimensions batati hain ke woh base quantities se kaise juri hai. Base quantities square brackets mein symbols se likhi jaati hain: length [L], mass [M], time [T], electric current [A], temperature [θ].
Kisi quantity ki dimensions likhne ke liye us ka formula likhein aur har quantity ki jagah us ki dimensions rakhein; ½ jaise numbers ki koi dimension nahi.
Misalein:
Speed v = faasla/waqt: [v] = [L]/[T] = [LT⁻¹]
Acceleration a = Δv/Δt: [a] = [LT⁻¹]/[T] = [LT⁻²]
Force F = ma: [F] = [M][LT⁻²] = [MLT⁻²]
Work W = Fd: [W] = [MLT⁻²][L] = [ML²T⁻²]
Density ρ = m/V: [ρ] = [M]/[L³] = [ML⁻³]
Do faide:
1. Equation ki homogeneity (durusti) check karna: dono taraf dimensions barabar honi chahiyein, maslan S = ½at² se [L] = [LT⁻²][T²] = [L], is liye durust hai.
2. Formula derive karna: agar maloom ho ke koi quantity kin cheezon par munhasir hai to formula ki shakal mil jaati hai, maslan centripetal force F = (constant) mv²/r (Example 1.4).
(Yeh tareeqa numerical constant ki qeemat nahi deta; woh tajurbe se milti hai.)

blocks.prompt:
1.5 Check the homogeneity of the relation:
v = √(T × ℓ / m)
where v is the speed of transverse wave on a stretched string of tension T, length ℓ and mass m.
(Is relation ki homogeneity check karein, jahan v tani hui taar par transverse wave ki speed, T tension, ℓ lambai aur m mass hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Baayein taraf ki dimensions: [v] = [LT⁻¹]
Tension aik force hai: [T] = [MLT⁻²]; [ℓ] = [L]; [m] = [M]
Daayein taraf ki dimensions = √([MLT⁻²][L] / [M]) = √[L²T⁻²] = [LT⁻¹]
Dono taraf [LT⁻¹] hai, is liye relation homogeneous (dimension mein durust) hai.

blocks.text: Numerical Problems (sawalat hal karein)

blocks.prompt:
1.1 Astronomers usually measure astronomical distances in light years. One light year is the distance that light travels in one year. If speed of light is 3 x 10⁸ m s⁻¹, what is one light year in metres? (Ans: 9.5x10¹⁵ m)
(Aik light year woh faasla hai jo roshni aik saal mein tay karti hai. Roshni ki speed 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ ho to aik light year kitne metre hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, t = 1 saal
Maloom karna: faasla S
t = 365 × 24 × 60 × 60 s = 3.15 × 10⁷ s
S = c × t
S = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ × 3.15 × 10⁷ s
S = 9.46 × 10¹⁵ m ≈ 9.5 × 10¹⁵ m
Yeh kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
1.2 Write the estimated answer of the following in standard form.
(a) How many seconds are there in 1 year?
(b) How many years are in 1 second?
(Ans: (a) 3.2 x 10⁷ s (b) 3.1 x 10⁻⁸ years)
(In ka andaza (estimated) jawab standard form mein likhein: (a) 1 saal mein kitne second? (b) 1 second kitne saal hai?)
blocks.explanation:
(a) 1 saal = 365 × 24 × 60 × 60 s = 31 536 000 s ≈ 3.2 × 10⁷ s
(b) 1 s = 1 / (3.2 × 10⁷) saal = 3.1 × 10⁻⁸ saal
Dono kitab ke jawab se milte hain (exact 3.15 × 10⁷ s lene se (b) 3.2 × 10⁻⁸ saal aata hai; kitab ne (a) ka andaza istemal kiya hai).

blocks.prompt:
1.3 The length and width of a rectangular plate are measured to be 18.3 cm and 14.60 cm, respectively. Find the area of the plate and state the answer to correct number of significant figures. (Ans: 267 cm²)
(Mustateel (rectangular) plate ki lambai 18.3 cm aur chaurai 14.60 cm hai. Plate ka area sahi significant figures mein maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: lambai ℓ = 18.3 cm (3 significant figures), chaurai b = 14.60 cm (4 significant figures)
Maloom karna: area A
A = ℓ × b = 18.3 cm × 14.60 cm = 267.18 cm²
Sab se kam durust factor 18.3 cm mein teen significant figures hain, is liye
A = 267 cm²
Yeh kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
1.4 Find the sum of the masses given in kg up to appropriate precision:
(i) 3.197 (ii) 0.068 (iii) 13.9 (iv) 3.28 (Ans: 20.4 kg)
(Kg mein di gayi masses ka majmua munasib precision tak maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Majmua = 3.197 kg + 0.068 kg + 13.9 kg + 3.28 kg = 20.445 kg
Sab se kam decimal places (aik) 13.9 kg mein hain, is liye jawab aik decimal tak:
20.445 → 20.44 → 20.4 kg
Yeh kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
1.5 The diameter and length of a metal cylinder measured with the help of a Vernier Callipers of least count 0.01 cm are 1.22 cm and 5.35 cm respectively. Calculate its volume and uncertainty in it. (Ans: 6.2 ± 0.1 cm³)
(0.01 cm least count wale Vernier Callipers se metal cylinder ka diameter 1.22 cm aur lambai 5.35 cm naapi gayi. Is ka volume aur us mein uncertainty maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: d = 1.22 cm, ℓ = 5.35 cm, least count = 0.01 cm
Maloom karna: volume V aur us ki uncertainty
V = π(d²/4)ℓ = 3.14 × (1.22 cm)² × 5.35 cm / 4 = 6.25 cm³
d mein %age uncertainty = (0.01 cm / 1.22 cm) × 100 = 0.82%; d² ke liye: 2 × 0.82% = 1.64%
ℓ mein %age uncertainty = (0.01 cm / 5.35 cm) × 100 = 0.19%
V mein kul %age uncertainty = 1.64% + 0.19% = 1.83%
Absolute uncertainty = 6.25 cm³ ka 1.83% = 0.11 cm³ ≈ 0.1 cm³ (aik significant figure)
Volume ko uncertainty ki jagah tak round karein: 6.25 → 6.2 (girne wala 5 juft (even) hindse 2 ke baad hai)
V = 6.2 ± 0.1 cm³
Yeh kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ka rounding usool: agar girne wala hindsa 5 ho to pichla hindsa taaq (odd) ho to aik barhao, juft (even) ho to waisa hi rakho. Is liye 6.25 → 6.2.

blocks.prompt:
1.6 Show that the expression vf² - vi² = 2aS is dimensionally correct, where vi is the initial velocity, a is the acceleration and vf is the velocity after covering a distance S.
(Sabit karein ke vf² - vi² = 2aS dimension ke lihaz se durust hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Baayein taraf: [vf²] - [vi²]; dono terms ki dimensions [LT⁻¹]² = [L²T⁻²]
Daayein taraf: 2 ki koi dimension nahi; [a][S] = [LT⁻²][L] = [L²T⁻²]
Dono taraf [L²T⁻²] hai, is liye expression dimension ke lihaz se durust hai.

blocks.prompt:
1.7 Show that the famous "Einstein equation" E = mc² is dimensionally consistent.
(Sabit karein ke Einstein ki mashhoor equation E = mc² dimension ke lihaz se durust hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Baayein taraf: E energy (work) hai: [E] = [ML²T⁻²]
Daayein taraf: [m][c]² = [M][LT⁻¹]² = [ML²T⁻²]
Dono taraf dimensions barabar hain, is liye E = mc² durust hai.

blocks.prompt:
1.8 Derive a formula for the time period of a simple pendulum using dimensional analysis. The various possible factors on which the time period T may depend are:
(i) length of the pendulum ℓ
(ii) mass of the bob m
(iii) angle θ which the thread makes with the vertical
(iv) accelerates due to gravity g.
(Ans: T = Constant √(ℓ/g))
(Dimensional analysis se simple pendulum ke time period ka formula derive karein, jab T lambai ℓ, bob ki mass m, angle θ aur g par munhasir ho sakta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Angle θ ki koi dimension nahi, is liye us ka asar constant mein chala jata hai aur is tareeqe se maloom nahi hota.
Farz karein T = (constant) ℓᵃ mᵇ gᶜ ...... (i)
Dimensions likhein (constant ki koi dimension nahi):
[T] = [L]ᵃ [M]ᵇ [LT⁻²]ᶜ
[M⁰L⁰T¹] = [Mᵇ Lᵃ⁺ᶜ T⁻²ᶜ]
Powers ka muqabla:
M: b = 0
T: -2c = 1, is liye c = -½
L: a + c = 0, is liye a = ½
a, b, c ko (i) mein rakhein:
T = (constant) ℓ^½ m⁰ g^(-½)
T = constant √(ℓ/g)
Time period bob ki mass par munhasir nahi. (Tajurbe se constant 2π aata hai: T = 2π√(ℓ/g).) Yeh kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Numericals ke kitab wale jawab (brackets mein) check kiye gaye; sab durust hain.
Vernier aur screw gauge wali tasveerein kitab mein bohat chhoti hain; un ki readings tasveer se andaza hain, is liye exam mein poora tareeqa likhein.
